options.title: Starbucks' boss vs its barista: how many of her years is his one? ☕
options.first_line: Starbucks pays its boss one year of pay. How many baristas' years is that?
options.first_frame: A Starbucks-green café counter: a barista hands a coffee over, and behind her a glass office door shows the CEO's real face, a giant pay cheque on his desk.

options.title: A Starbucks barista earns {fact2} a year. What does the CEO earn? ☕
options.first_line: A Starbucks barista works a whole year for {fact2}. So how long does her boss take to earn it?
options.first_frame: A barista behind a green café counter holding up a year's pay slip, the CEO's photo head grinning on a poster above the espresso machine.

options.title: Starbucks cut its CEO's pay. Is it still more than a barista's? ☕
options.first_line: Starbucks just cut its CEO Brian Niccol's pay. So is it any closer to the barista making your latte?
options.first_frame: Giant scissors snipping a huge cheque with Brian Niccol's real face on it, a barista watching from a green café counter.

why: It names a person you see every day and her real yearly pay, then asks how long her boss takes to earn it, a question you can only answer by staying, while A's 'years of years' is clumsy and C's answer (obviously yes) is given away.
